title: Monster in My Family
description:
S01 E02 — Spokane Serial Killer: Robert Lee Yates
Amber and Michelle Yates discuss being raised by a man who terrorized the city of Spokane, Wash.; in an effort to find healing, the Yates sisters meet with the sister of one of their father's victims.

title: Cold Case Files: The Rifkin Murders
description:
S01 E01 — Part 1
A TV producer leverages his relationship with Joel Rifkin, New York's most prolific serial killer, to get information police could use to discover the identities of the two remaining unknown victims.

title: Cold Case Files: The Rifkin Murders
description:
S01 E02 — Part 2
After 30 years, serial killer Joel Rifkin provides clues to New York State Police to identify two of his 17 victims, the only who remain nameless.

title: Monster in My Family
description:
S01 E01 — Happy Face Killer: Keith Hunter Jesperson
Melissa Moore, daughter of Keith Hunter Jesperson, tells her story as the daughter of a serial killer; Melissa meets a family member of one of her father's victims.

title: Monster in My Family
description:
S01 E03 — Phoenix Serial Shooter: Dale Hausner
Randy Hausner reveals how his brother terrorized the city of Phoenix in a killing spree; Randy meets with a shooting survivor and with the son of a man killed by his brother.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E08 — Cheerleader on Trial
High school senior Skylar Richardson tells no one of her pregnancy; however, she is charged with murder after a newborn baby's body is found buried in her family's backyard.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E02 — Murder and the Sex Cam Model
Margaret and Chad Amato are found dead with their son in their Florida Home; middle son Grant Amato is accused of killing his family, despite a seeming lack of evidence.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E09 — The Farmer's Wife
Shirley Carter is found murdered in her farmhouse kitchen, her abusive husband, Bill, is considered a prime suspect; the husband points the finger at their son, Jason; it's left up to the jury to decide who to believe.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E06 — Killing Momma
An investigation into the murder of Dee Dee Blanchard, who is found face down in the bedroom of her house just outside Springfield, Mo., in June 2015.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E12 — Murder at Ohio State
When Ohio State senior Reagan Tokes fails to respond to messages from her parents, they fear the worst; a caller reports the discovery of a female body in the local park; detectives race to solve the crime.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E07 — Murder in Palm Beach County
Makeva Jenkins, a successful businesswoman and mother of three, boasts on Facebook that she has grown her business to six figures; hours later, she is shot dead with a bullet to the head.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E03 — Murder in the Kentucky Hills
Shayna Hubers calls 911 to report she has killed her boyfriend in self-defense; however, investigators soon learn he was planning a date with another woman and suspect Shayna killed him in a jealous rage.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E16 — The Breaking Point
When a family is found murdered near Roswell, N.M., the 14-year-old killer is brought to justice.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S04 E04 — Assassin and the Matrix Kid
A young married couple is found murdered execution-style inside their new home; a teenage boy descends into a state of mental confusion as his obsession with a violent movie character causes his world to blend fiction and reality.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E07 — Simon Says & For No Good Reason
An outcast joins a military-style cult of misfit teenagers; two high school football players share the fantasy of committing an armed robbery.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E11 — No Apparent Motive
Upon visiting the home of a woman found strangled to death in a local park, police discover her family has been murdered as well.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E17 — Raging Hormones
A teen forms a friendship in an Internet chat room that takes him down a dark road; a real monster stalks the town of Amarillo on Halloween night in 1979.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E21 — Deadly Compulsion
A 16-year-old girl who lives across the street from an elementary school begins shooting at students from her window; in May 2007, experts are called to investigate a bloody crime scene in Manheim Township.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E06 — The Million Dollar Plan & Rattlesnake Romeo

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E04 — Death of a Hero
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo; a closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E05 — The Heartland Killer
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E12 — Damn His Soul to Hell
The 1964 murder of 9-year-old Marise Chiverella leaves the town of Hazleton, Pa., in fear; an intense manhunt yields numerous suspects but no killer; five decades pass before a student moonlighting as a genetic genealogist reignites the case.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E03 — Death of a Baseball Mom
When beloved mother and sister Janora Stevens is found brutally stabbed in her Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, her family is divided and increasingly suspicious of each other; the case chills until a trail of tell-tale fibers leads cops to her killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E17 — Sisters in Death
In 1984, Jack Kennedy discovers his daughters brutally murdered; their mother and niece spend their lives keeping the case alive; thirty years later, an informant gives up a name, but the family's ordeal is far from over.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E18 — One Tough Mother
In July 1997, the brutal murder of 19-year-old Tiffany Johnston rocks the small town of Bethany, Okla.; DNA evidence points to her killer over a decade later and leads to the buried bodies of two other missing women in Texas.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E23 — A Is for Arson
When firefighter Gary Parks is killed in a fire ruled to be arson, the investigation into his death shifts to homicide; a serial arsonist is thought to be the culprit, but it takes a dogged cold-case detective to track down the real killer.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E09 — Mapping a Murder
After the gruesome murder of an aspiring actor in Georgia, police quickly run out of leads; a new digital forensic tool breathes life into the investigation, allowing authorities to identify the killer with pinpoint precision.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E02 — Dark Mode
When two teenage classmates in Northern California go missing within weeks of each other, their mothers struggle to get police to take the situation seriously; but then, unusual cell phone activity by a group of potential suspects gets scrutinized.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E04 — Caught in the App
Detectives in Aurora gather crucial information about a double homicide from neighborhood surveillance footage, but they're not able to identify and track the killer until some key digital data is uncovered.
